tool-task-handoff-picker.title: Use this tool for a project task
tool-task-handoff-picker.description: Choose an existing task, check its current record and the exact tool, then continue to the original dispatch plan.
tool-task-handoff-picker.task_hint: Continue rereads the current task version; a list observation cannot authorize dispatch.
tool-task-handoff-picker.empty: No tasks in this scope. Create a project task first.
tool-task-handoff-picker.boundary: This only selects a task. It does not create a task, start execution or change a tool. Choose a workflow, configure model budgets and review the dispatch plan separately.
tool-task-handoff-picker.unavailable: The current tool or workspace cannot be used for a task. Return to tool details and check it again.
tool-task-handoff-picker.changed: The task or tool basis changed. Return to its details and check again; another configuration will not be substituted.
tool-task-handoff-picker.invalid_page: The task list is incomplete. Read the current project tasks again.
tool-task-handoff-picker.invalid_search: Enter up to 200 valid search characters, without control characters or whitespace-only text.
